nodes.label: Phase 0 Semantic Token System (night/paper)
nodes.rationale: Night values live on :root because <html> already carries className='dark' and body uses bg-dark-primary, so there is zero visual change at the end of Phase 0; html.theme-light (paper) is an opt-in capability whose toggling is Phase 1's job. Legacy names (--brand-red/--bg-*/--text-*/--border-color/--color-*) are kept as aliases so existing inline-style components keep working until full migration. Status tones add -subtle variants; shadows are tinted to background hue.

nodes.label: Typography System (Sora display + JetBrains Mono numerals)
nodes.rationale: Spec §3.2: Sora (600/700) for masthead/display/headings as the 'newsroom voice'; JetBrains Mono (400/500/600) for numbers/IDs/clocks/counts/timestamps; Inter stays as body font. Exposed as --font-sora/--font-mono CSS variables via next/font/google for the Tailwind config.
nodes.norm_label: typography system (sora display + jetbrains mono numerals)

nodes.label: Tailwind Token Mapping (surface/text/accent/status)
nodes.rationale: Maps CSS variables from Task 2 into utilities bg-surface-0..3, text-text-1..3, border-border, accent, status colors, font families, radius and shadow lvl tokens. Keeps legacy santos/dark/light palettes until migration is complete. border needs a DEFAULT color key so Tailwind emits border-border.

nodes.label: Base ui/ Kit (Button, Card, Badge, StatusPill, Input, Select, Table, Dropdown)
nodes.rationale: Primitive API consumed by every later phase; prop contracts (variant/tone/status/columns) are stable contracts for Phases 1-4. 'use client' only where state lives (Select, Dropdown, Table sort).
nodes.norm_label: base ui/ kit (button, card, badge, statuspill, input, select, table, dropdown)

nodes.label: StatusPill Announcement Status Pill
nodes.rationale: Presentational only: maps the 5-state union (draft|scheduled|published|taken-down|pending-approval) to tone+icon+Indonesian label. Derivation logic deriveAnnouncementStatus lands in Phase 2 (spec §5.1), so the pill stays honest without pulling announcement queries into the foundation.

nodes.label: AdminSiteThemeProvider (masthead --site-primary driver)
nodes.rationale: Server component that resolves the admin's active site (resolveAdminSiteId) and feeds SiteThemeProvider so --site-primary follows the masthead site. --accent: var(--site-primary, var(--brand-red)) in BOTH theme blocks. Fallback #ED1C24/"Site" keeps the shell safe when no site is selected.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Verification Gates (token audit 7/7)
nodes.rationale: Standing gate set for the rework: npx tsc --noEmit + npx eslint + token-audit script (night+paper surfaces/text/border resolve per spec §3.1, accent wired to --site-primary in both themes). npm run build is SKIPPED because the env is pre-existing-broken (empty NEXTAUTH_URL), a user ruling keeps .env untouched.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Design System Foundation
nodes.rationale: Shipped commits 1b7c53a..31c63d2. Deferrals by design: motion tokens (spec §3.4) to Phase 1 shell, deriveAnnouncementStatus to Phase 2, sortable ledger to Phase 3. Phase 0 defaults to night to avoid a full-app visual flip; .theme-light built but untoggled.

nodes.label: Pre-existing Build/Env Constraint (empty NEXTAUTH_URL)
nodes.rationale: npm run build fails pre-existing (empty NEXTAUTH_URL -> /portal-login prerender TypeError: Invalid URL); local Postgres is down; dev cannot render any route (pre-existing localStorage.getItem error). User ruling: keep .env as-is; do NOT touch .env or env-related build code. Gate with tsc + eslint + scoped visual inspection instead.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Admin Shell
nodes.rationale: Shipped 98a0982..e2a6748: shared nav model, sidebar, topbar, Ctrl+K palette, masthead rack. Content/site search and rack live counts deferred to Phase 2; theme toggle deferred per plan. Some tasks inline-authored by coordinator after subagent instability.

nodes.label: Shared Admin Nav Model (lib/admin-nav.ts)
nodes.rationale: AdminNavItem + adminNavGroups is the SINGLE source of nav truth consumed by both the sidebar (Task 2) and the command palette (Task 4). Groups: Kantor/Terbit/Saluran(superAdminOnly)/Sistem. findActiveAdminItem does exact pathname matches.

nodes.label: Grouped Collapsible Token-Native Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Icon rail w-16 collapsed / w-60 expanded; collapse persisted per user via localStorage key adminSidebarCollapsed; mobile always expanded-as-overlay. Active item bg-accent/10 + border-l-2 border-accent + aria-current=page.

nodes.label: Masthead Topbar (breadcrumb + channel strip + live clock)
nodes.rationale: Breadcrumb from findActiveAdminItem; channel strip (site dot+name+slug) from useSiteTheme; live mono clock; user menu uses kit Dropdown (Profil/Pengaturan/Keluar with signOut callbackUrl /admin-login).
nodes.norm_label: masthead topbar (breadcrumb + channel strip + live clock)

nodes.label: Ctrl+K Command Palette
nodes.rationale: Spec §4.1: global Ctrl/Cmd+K overlay palette searching over actions ('Buat pengumuman baru'), content placeholder, and sites placeholder; ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape navigation; content/site search itself is deferred to Phase 2.

nodes.label: MastheadRack Site Switcher
nodes.rationale: Token-native rack replacing SiteSelector: swatch+name+slug+count, /api/context sync + reload, useToast on failure, clicked-outside close, aria-haspopup/expanded.

nodes.label: Portal Shell + App Grid Restructure (Plan 11-02)
nodes.rationale: Token-рnative portal shell/header plus D-01 grid restructure: chips + responsive 1/2/3/4 columns and kit AppCard. 375px guarantee: base grid-cols-1, header collapses to wordmark + Keluar + toggle.

nodes.label: GroupedAppGrid Chips + Responsive Grid (D-01)
nodes.rationale: Chip selection is PURE client state (useState) — no fetch, no URL change, no new server queries. Chips use aria-pressed + role=group; group ordering comes from server groups, NOT PortalApp.category. Grid 1-col base keeps 375px scroll-free; no client re-sort.

nodes.label: AppCard Launch Card (ui kit)
nodes.rationale: Kit Card with hover lift, single focusable CTA (keyboard order = visual), CSS line-clamp replaces substring truncation, health row uses mono tabular-nums count; CTA Buka / Simpan Kredensial.

nodes.label: Locked Empty-State + Copy Contracts
nodes.rationale: Copy byte-verified against UI-SPEC ('Belum ada aplikasi', 'Tidak ada aplikasi yang dapat ditampilkan saat ini...', CTA Buka Pengaturan -> /portal/settings). Group variant 'Belum ada aplikasi di grup ini.' is defensive dead code today but implements the locked group-scoped contract.

nodes.label: OPD-1 Frozen Data Pipeline (portal)
nodes.rationale: Data pipeline 100% frozen: getServerSession -> getPortalLayout -> needsOnboarding gate -> getAccessiblePortalApps -> groupBy; git diff on lib/portal-access.ts + lib/portal-layout.ts is empty — presentation-only diffs enforced with greps (3/1/2 matches).

nodes.label: Portal SSO Secondary Surfaces Wave (Plan 11-03)
nodes.rationale: Wave 2 of the portal-restyle: 11 files restyled, 0 new capabilities; SSO launch behavior and API contracts frozen. All copy verbatim per UI-SPEC copywriting; text sizes 12/14/20/24 only and weights 400/600 only.

nodes.label: Centered Failure/Denied Sheet Family
nodes.rationale: AccessDenied/NoCredential/CorruptCredential share one centered sheet: 56px icon tile (warning/danger tones), font-display title, verbatim body copy; CTAs keep identical hrefs.

nodes.label: AccountSelector Sheet (?credentialId selection)
nodes.rationale: Centered sheet with mono credential-id sub-line; row href ?credentialId unchanged; new 'Batal' ghost CTA per locked contract.

nodes.label: SSO Interstitials (auto-submit / reroute)
nodes.rationale: SSOAutoSubmit/SSORerouteSubmit sheets with 56px logo tile, animate-spin loader; the 1.5s timer and hidden form fields are frozen byte-identical; only style={{display:'none'}} became className='hidden'.

nodes.label: SSO Credential Vault
nodes.rationale: Mono username/password rows in a Vault mode with copy/hide buttons (42px ghost), copied flash Check; copyText (clipboard + execCommand fallback) and window.open noopener,noreferrer byte-identical; no delete added.

nodes.label: OnboardingWizard + VisibilitySettings
nodes.rationale: Single-screen wizard (assumption GS §7.3, no invented step navigation) with accent checkboxes; body construction (groupIdsOff/appIdsOff/appIdsOn/skip, fetch /api/portal/visibility, redirect /portal) byte-identical; VisibilitySettings renders wizard in settings mode.

nodes.label: Portal Credentials Page (accordion + form)
nodes.rationale: Kit accordion cards with health line, danger ghost delete via ConfirmDialog, kit inputs/button, empty tile with Key 24. GET/POST/DELETE payloads and ?credentialId param byte-identical; password rows never prefilled (PORT-08).

nodes.label: Frozen Form/API Byte-Identity Gate
nodes.rationale: Pre-commit git diff filtered to method=|action=|type=hidden lines prints NOTHING; field-name/value/order sets unchanged (counts 5/4 match plan). Visibility POST body construction and credential API URLs byte-identical — diff-proven.

nodes.label: Phosphor Icon Name Migration (v2.1.10)
nodes.rationale: Version 2 renamed icons: WarningTriangle does not exist -> Warning; ExternalLink -> ArrowSquareOut; Home exists only in v1 line icons -> House; MessageCircle -> ChatCircleDots; PieChart -> ChartPie; FiExternalLink mapping. Only named top-level imports allowed.

nodes.label: Portal Admin Ledgers Restyle (Plan 11-04)
nodes.rationale: 5 admin pages (portal-sessions/audit/users/apps/groups) rewritten token-native with Table-kit sortable ledgers, badges, modals, pagination, Deteksi Otomatis; API contract diff vs base frozen (0 changed fetch/method/body lines); 14 no-explicit-any warnings inherited, not regressions.

nodes.label: Manual E2E Checklist (9 steps)
nodes.rationale: 9-step manual checklist (login -> grid -> simpan cred -> SSO -> picker -> gagal -> lockout -> revoke -> audit) plus automation evidence for OPD-1/OPD-4/scope; lockout step added per review.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Content Desk Plan
nodes.rationale: Written, not yet executed: truthful announcement status derived from isPublished/scheduledAt/takedownAt; announce-ledger StatusPill-driven; two-pane composer with preview; categories/media/comments/newsletter desks token-native; absorbs deferred Phase 1 items (motion tokens, theme toggle, palette content/site search, rack live counts).

nodes.label: deriveAnnouncementStatus (truthful status logic)
nodes.rationale: New helper derives draft/terjadwal/terbit/diturunkan from flags — no new schema, approval model was dropped by migration 20260605010000; StatusPill's pending-approval stays in the union but is NEVER emitted by the new helper.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Data Surfaces Plan
nodes.rationale: Spec §6: chart language (recharts masthead-aware), StatTile KPIs, sortable ledger tables (Sites?Users), audit trail timeline ledger, global analytics masthead comparison. Base: current main HEAD.

nodes.label: Masthead-Aware Chart Theme
nodes.rationale: getChartTheme() drives chart color so the primary series follows the active masthead via useSiteTheme()/--site-primary; other series neutral + one contrast color.

nodes.label: StatTile KPI Tile
nodes.rationale: Sparse stat tiles, not boxed cards: big mono numeral + optional delta + 16px icon, headline reading.

nodes.label: Sortable Ledger Tables
nodes.rationale: Sites+Users desks rebuilt on already-sortable Table kit (aria-sort, mono numerics, filter/pagination); audit trail becomes a timeline-style ledger with filters+export CSV/JSON preserved.

nodes.label: UI/UX Rework Phase Roadmap (spec §8 sequence)
nodes.rationale: Sequential phases: 0 design system, 1 shell, 2 content desk, 3 data surfaces, 4 portal ledgers (portal-sessions/audit/users/groups) and auth frames per spec §8. Behavior-preservation boundary ruling the roadmap.

nodes.label: Multi-Site Core Domain Model (AnnouncementSite junction)
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenant announcement CMS: Announcement<->Site many-to-many via AnnouncementSite junction with isPrimary; never assume single site per announcement; query through .some and derive primarySite from the junction. Category/NewsletterSubscriber/SiteSettings hard-scoped to siteId; MediaLibrary/ActivityLog/EmailTemplate nullable siteId.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Access Control (SuperAdmin + UserSiteAccess)
nodes.rationale: isSuperAdmin flag bypasses all site checks; UserSiteAccess gives per-site SiteRole (SITE_ADMIN > EDITOR > VIEWER) separate from global User.role. All writes go through lib/site-access.ts helpers (canEditOnSite/canAdminSite/getAccessibleSites) — API routes loop target siteIds and gate each.

nodes.label: Portal SSO Layer (PortalUser + encrypted credentials)
nodes.rationale: Separate NextAuth instance (portal-auth.* cookie), AES-256-GCM credential encryption, RBAC helpers; SSO via form-based credential forwarding auto-submitting POST to app loginUrl. /portal-login -> /portal grid -> /portal/app/[slug] launch flow.

nodes.label: Audit Trail (AuditLog single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: AuditLog is the single source of truth for admin/portal/system transactions via logAudit(); non-blocking, never throws, auto-redacts secrets; never write audit_logs directly. ActivityLog retained+backfilled; SuperAdmin-only /admin/audit-trail with export.
nodes.norm_label: audit trail (auditlog single source of truth)

nodes.label: Site Context Propagation (httpOnly cookies)
nodes.rationale: Current site stored in httpOnly cookies current_site_id/current_site_slug managed by lib/site-context.ts; public routes are path-based /site/[siteSlug]/...; legacy /article etc. 301-redirect into /site/sja-utama.

nodes.label: Request Pipeline & API Route Conventions
nodes.rationale: middleware.ts root redirect + security headers + in-memory IP rate limiting; API routes: getServerSession, Zod validateInput + formatZodErrors, sanitizeHTML (DOMPurify) for ALL HTML; mutations write ActivityLog. Prisma singleton via lib/prisma.ts.

nodes.label: JWT Auth with DB-Backed Session Revocation
nodes.rationale: NextAuth JWT strategy; every token refresh re-checks UserSession.isRevoked/expiresAt and clears token if invalid (fail-open on DB error); sign-in creates a UserSession row; /admin-login.
nodes.norm_label: jwt auth with db-backed session revocation

nodes.label: Throttled Scheduler (auto-publish/takedown)
nodes.rationale: No external cron: runScheduler() throttled 60s, invoked from server render; auto-publishes scheduledAt <= now and auto-takes-down takedownAt <= now; protected /api/scheduler with CRON_SECRET.

nodes.label: Domain Docs Consumption (CONTEXT.md + ADRs)
nodes.rationale: Single-context = one CONTEXT.md at root; multi-context = CONTEXT-MAP.md pointing to per-context CONTEXT.md; docs/adr/ for single-source decisions and src/<context>/docs/adr/ for context-scoped ones. Read them before exploring.

nodes.label: ADR Conflict Surfacing
nodes.rationale: If output contradicts an existing ADR: surface explicitly instead of silently overriding; use the glossary's vocabulary for concepts.

nodes.label: GitHub Issue Tracker (gh CLI)
nodes.rationale: Issues and specs in repo torpedoliar/Anouncement-Dashboard-Local; gh issue create/view/list --comments/comment/edit --add-label/close; PRs as a request surface: NO (flag).

nodes.label: Wayfinder Map Issue + Child Tickets
nodes.rationale: A single GitHub issue labeled wayfinder:map holds Notes/Decisions-so-far/Fog; child tickets are sub-issues with wayfinder:<type> labels; blocking uses native issue dependencies, frontier query picks first open child without blockers.

nodes.label: Semantic Token System (night/paper CSS variables)
nodes.rationale: Design system foundation must not break existing inline-style components: new semantic tokens (--surface-0..3, --text-1..3, --border, --accent) are defined on :root as night defaults with html.theme-light for paper; legacy var(--brand-red)/--bg-*/--text-*/--border-* names are kept as aliases to the new tokens so the app renders identically at the end of Phase 0 (no visual regression).

nodes.label: Night Edition (default theme)
nodes.rationale: Night values stay on :root as default so the app (already running .dark on html with a black UI) has zero visual change at the end of Phase 0; the .theme-light block is the capability, toggling it on is Phase 1/2's job.

nodes.label: Backward-Compatible CSS Variable Aliases
nodes.rationale: Every existing component uses inline style={{}} referencing var(--brand-red), var(--bg-*), var(--text-*), var(--border-color) etc. These MUST keep resolving as aliases to the new tokens at the end of Phase 0 or the sidebar/confirm-dialog etc. break visually; remove the aliases later after full migration.

nodes.label: Tokenize Then Migrate Approach
nodes.rationale: Explicit tokenize then migrate, not a one-shot rewrite: design system first, then workstream-by-workstream migration; each phase is a self-contained shippable slice so there is no long dark period and every step is testable.

nodes.label: Base ui/ Kit (Button, Card, Badge, StatusPill, Input, Select, Table, Dropdown)
nodes.rationale: Small token-driven kit under components/ui/, Tailwind-class based (token utilities), NOT inline-style; component prop contracts (variant/tone/status/columns/sort/onSort) are stable contracts consumed by every later phase.
nodes.norm_label: base ui/ kit (button, card, badge, statuspill, input, select, table, dropdown)

nodes.label: StatusPill Component
nodes.rationale: Presentational only in Phase 0: maps status -> tone + Phosphor icon + Indonesian default label; the honest derivation logic (deriveAnnouncementStatus, spec 5.1) deliberately lands in Phase 2 so the foundation phase stays honest without pulling announcement queries in.

nodes.label: AdminSiteThemeProvider (server component)
nodes.rationale: Server wrapper that resolves the admin active site (resolveAdminSiteId + prisma.site.findUnique primaryColor) and feeds it to the existing client SiteThemeProvider so the per-site masthead color drives --site-primary inside the admin shell; no color logic duplicated (adjustBrightness/getContrastColor stay in SiteThemeProvider).

nodes.label: Site-Primary Masthead Accent Variable (--site-primary)
nodes.rationale: Per-site masthead accent injected by SiteThemeProvider (default #ED1C24 brand red); --accent defaults to var(--brand-red) and is overridden by --site-primary; drives focus rings, scrollbar, ::selection, accent utilities, and (later) charts.

nodes.label: Tailwind Config Token Mapping
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v3 extend maps semantic CSS vars to utilities (bg-surface-0..3, text-text-1..3, border-border, bg/text/border-accent, status colors, display/mono font families, token radius and shadow-lvl-*) so the kit and later phases never write raw hex.

nodes.label: Shared Admin Nav Model (lib/admin-nav.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single declarative nav source: AdminNavItem/AdminNavGroup (Kantor/Terbit/Saluran/Sistem, superAdminOnly group flag) consumed by the sidebar and the command palette so nav stays consistent.

nodes.label: Grouped Collapsible AdminSidebar
nodes.rationale: Token-native rewrite of the ~100% inline-style sidebar: 64px icon rail -> 240px expanded, sentence-case group headers, active item bg-accent/10 + border-l-2 border-accent + aria-current, collapse persisted in localStorage adminSidebarCollapsed, mobile hamburger/slide-over preserved.

nodes.label: Masthead Topbar (breadcrumb + channel strip + live clock + user menu)
nodes.norm_label: masthead topbar (breadcrumb + channel strip + live clock + user menu)

nodes.label: Ctrl+K Command Palette
nodes.rationale: Global Ctrl+K/Cmd+K palette searching actions ("Buat pengumuman baru"), content (jump to an announcement) and sites (switch masthead); content search deferred to Phase 2 needs the search API, full site-switch surfaces in Phase 2 as well.

nodes.label: MastheadRack (site switcher with swatch + slug + counts)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the plain SiteSelector: each site = color swatch + name + slug + live counts; re-tints via SiteThemeProvider (accent follows chosen site); count honesty (live/scheduled) is Phase 2 - initially only total syndications from _count.announcementSites.
nodes.norm_label: mastheadrack (site switcher with swatch + slug + counts)

nodes.label: useSiteTheme Hook
nodes.rationale: From SiteThemeProvider: exposes the active site theme {theme: {primaryColor, ...}, siteName} to client components (topbar channel strip, charts in Phase 3).

nodes.label: deriveAnnouncementStatus Helper (lib/announcement-status.ts)
nodes.rationale: Announcement state is derived, not stored (model has isPublished + scheduledAt/takedownAt, no status enum). Precedence: a passed takedownAt wins first, a future scheduledAt next, isPublished next, else draft; optional now param for testable fixed time instants; shared by list + editor + scheduler surfaces so pill and actual state stay honest.

nodes.label: Semantic Motion Tokens (--motion-fast/standard/ease)
nodes.rationale: 150-300ms micro-interactions, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform/opacity only, faster exits, prefers-reduced-motion honored; added as custom properties in globals.css; no animating layout dimensions.

nodes.label: Light/Night Theme Toggle (admin topbar)
nodes.rationale: Compact labeled toggle persisting adminTheme (light|dark) in localStorage, applies/removes theme-light on document.documentElement, initializes from saved value or the existing night default; no second token set - html.theme-light and root night tokens already exist.

nodes.label: Announcement Ledger (news desk list)
nodes.rationale: Ledger list not a card wall: status pill + title + category + primary site + author + word count + updated time (derive primary site from junction flags - never assume one site); real filters (status via deriveAnnouncementStatus, keyword, category), bulk actions preserved; state is derived not stored.

nodes.label: Approval Workflow Boundary (pending-approval union)
nodes.rationale: The approval workflow was removed by migration (20260605010000); do not add approval UI or schema. The existing pending-approval presentation union remains untouched unless a later feature restores its data source.

nodes.label: Masthead-Aware Chart Language
nodes.rationale: Trends -> line/area, comparisons -> bar, proportions -> 1 donut max. No 3D, no decorative gradients. Primary series = active masthead accent (--site-primary via useSiteTheme), other series neutral (--text-3/--surface-3 family), one contrast series max. Legends always visible near chart, gridlines --border, tooltips shell-styled with mono numerals, empty state "Belum ada data untuk rentang ini" + range picker, loading skeleton.

nodes.label: StatTile (headline KPI tile)
nodes.rationale: Newspaper-headline reading: big mono number + optional delta line (CaretUp/CaretDown, success/danger tone), 16px icon, sparse layout with bottom-border divider NOT boxed cards, id-ID formatted numbers; delta only included when a real comparison source exists - never invent a delta query.

nodes.label: ChartTooltip (recharts content renderer)
nodes.rationale: Recharts-compatible content renderer styled to the shell (surface-1 bg, border-border, mono tabular-nums values, id-ID formatting); loose typing on recharts callback props is idiomatic - the library own types are cumbersome; scoped to near-axis code only.

nodes.label: getChartTheme() Helper (lib/chart-theme.ts)
nodes.rationale: One function returning CSS-variable tokens {primary, neutral, grid, tick, tooltipBg, tooltipBorder} - browser resolves them per theme (light/night) at paint time, so no JS theme detection needed; primary = masthead primaryColor with fallback var(--site-primary).

nodes.label: Sites Desk Health Cards
nodes.rationale: Token-native site cards (NOT a dense table - changing it would drop health metrics); honest live/scheduled counts line near the masthead swatch; health status = Badge tone + Phosphor icon + text, never color alone; per-site primaryColor swatch stays inline (DB data color, not chrome).

nodes.label: Users Ledger (sortable Table kit + role badges)
nodes.norm_label: users ledger (sortable table kit + role badges)

nodes.label: Audit Trail Timeline Ledger
nodes.rationale: Timeline-style ledger, not a dense log: vertical rail + timestamp, actor Badge, action verb, entity (truncated mono id), outcome/severity badges with icon + tone; filter by actor/type/date, export preserved, expandable details in a pre block.

nodes.label: Global Analytics Masthead Comparison (multi-site)
nodes.rationale: Per spec 6.5: compact color-dotted strip per site (primaryColor swatch, name, /site/{slug}, mono headline numbers) + grouped bar chart across sites with per-site primaryColor bars; SuperAdmin/cross-site page so accents are per-card site colors, not a single masthead accent; N+1 fetch pattern preserved (no API change).

nodes.label: One Newsroom, Many Mastheads (identity model)
nodes.rationale: The app is a publishing house: the Newsroom (app-wide stable shell) + the Masthead (per-site identity: primaryColor, name, slug - tints accents, nav, focus rings, charts) + the Byline (per-user identity/roles/session/audit). Audience: internal editors (speed + legibility) AND client-facing demos (premium + on-brand); brand red remains the default accent.

nodes.label: Token Architecture (spec 3.1)
nodes.rationale: Semantic CSS variables mapped into Tailwind; both themes from the same token set with contrast-tested parity (AA body 4.5:1, large 3:1); one radius scale (controls 6px/cards 8px/sheets 12px/accent bars 2px), spacing 4/8/16/24/32/48, shadows tinted to background hue (no pure-black drop shadows in light mode).

nodes.label: Derived Announcement Status Publishing Language
nodes.rationale: Status pills as a publishing language - color + icon, never color alone. State is derived, not stored (isPublished + scheduledAt/takedownAt, no enum). Table: Draf (!isPublished && !scheduledAt, neutral), Schedule (future scheduledAt, amber clock), Terbit (isPublished, success), Diturunkan (takedownAt passed, subtle); shared deriveAnnouncementStatus() reused by list + editor + scheduler so pill and actual state stay honest.

nodes.label: Non-Goals (preserved constraints)
nodes.rationale: No behavior changes: route slugs and information architecture, Indonesian UI language, brand red as default accent (site tint is an extension not a replacement), existing accessibility wins (skip link, reduced-motion, focus-visible, sr-only), and data model/auth/SSO/scheduler/audit logic all preserved - a chrome/shell/design-system-only rework.

nodes.label: Phase 4 - Portal & Auth Screens (boundary)
nodes.rationale: Last phase: shared auth frame (admin-login, portal-login), portal app grid launch cards, portal secondary surfaces (settings, credential vault, onboarding wizard, account selector, access denied, portal header), portal sessions/audit/users/groups ledgers; explicitly out of Phase 3 scope.
